messages.subject: Extracting probe level intensities
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I was wondering if its possible to extract probe level intensities from cel files without depending on a particular CDF file?

At the moment I am using:

df <- readDataFrame(getCdf(cs), verbose=-80)
raw<-extractMatrix(cs,cells=df$cell,verbose=verbose)

But its dependent on the CDF file thus we will only have probes that are included within the CDF. However we want the intensities for all probes irrespective of the CDF used.

Is this possible in aroma.affymetrix?

Regards,
Sanj

just exclude argument 'cells', i.e.

This will reads all cells/probes.

Henrik

messages.body_plain:
You most likely got an error during installation, because
aroma.affymetrix now requires R (≥ 3.1.2) -
https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/aroma.affymetrix/ - and you're
on R 3.1.0, which is nearly two years old.

The solution is to update to a recent version of R, i.e. R 3.2.4.
FYI, R 3.3.0 is coming in a few weeks.

/Henrik
